definitions.exact_inverse: for delta>0, W_ij=R_ij/(mi-mj), W_ii=0; diagonal R must vanish
definitions.observed_relation: Mhat has distinct eigenvalues with gap deltahat>0; What is the unique least-squares minimizer over skew X of ||[Mhat,X]-Rhat||F
definitions.space: real 3x3 matrices; M and Mhat symmetric, W and What skew; Frobenius norm except operator norm for DeltaM

exact_targets: rank of X -> [M,X] on so(3) equals 3 when delta>0; kernel zero
deltahat >= delta-2 epsilon_M for ordered eigenvalue matching
controls: repeated eigenvalues give nontrivial kernel and no 1/delta inverse
diagonal residual mismatch remains diagnostic and is not silently fitted
exclusions: brightness derivative, collisions, energy boundary, transport
